== Biography ==
Cristóbal Arróspide is from Santiago, Chile.

== Trivia ==
* Mostly known for being one of the best {{ci|Irelia}}, in the soloqueue of multiple regions.
* Started to play back in Season 2, influenced by his brother.
* Reached Challenger for the first time in Season 6.
* Reached Challenger in the NA server at Season 11.
* He likes anime.
* Nicknamed "'''Mewing Carry'''" by [[cody]].<ref>[https://x.com/LTASul/status/1882171380617130376 LTA Sul's X Post] ''x.com''</ref>
